original_control.problem: With initial_q=C0, the intentionally corrupted XOR row (q=v1,x=v1) is unreachable, so the control would not necessarily create a W9-visible semantic mismatch.

corrected_control.reason: At x=v1 the pre-update state is q=v1, so the corrupted XOR (v1,v1) row is exercised and changes the post-update branch result.
